reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with our experience with Water Wizard! From the very beginning, Steve & his team helped bring our vision to life and made the entire process smooth.  From design to final completion, everything was handled with professionalism, communication, and care.

Our backyard presented a major challenge with its steep uphill slope, but Water Wizard handled it flawlessly. Steve coordinated with an engineering team to ensure every aspect of the build was up to code, safe, and structurally sound. The extra time and care they took gave us complete confidence.

Our project supervisor Alex was outstanding. He was onsite almost every day, kept us informed throughout the build, and ensured everything was done to the highest standard. The attention to detail and commitment to quality shows as our pool turned out absolutely as we wanted.

We’ve already recommended Water Wizard to several friends and would 100% choose them again if we ever built another pool. Thank you to the entire team for making this such a great experience!
reviews.author: Taryn Compton

reviews.text: Really happy with Water Wizard Pools, who built my pool earlier this year.  It has been such a fun addition for our family to enjoy. My pool turned out even better than I expected. Definitely recommend them!
reviews.author: Miranda Whethers

reviews.text: Water Wizard Pools did an exceptional job at renovating my pool. They communicated frequently, and made sure I was aware of the problems I was facing with my situation. They were quick, professional, and very detailed. I am very happy with their work.
reviews.author: Andrew Markovitz

reviews.text:
This company deserves 5 plus 🌟! From the moment we met Steve (owner) and all thru the build, we were very happy, and  confident that we chose the BEST of THE BEST to build our pool. We researched companies for 6 mos before we reached out to get a bid.
Their communication, crews and workmanship are top notch! Do not waste your time- give them a call!
reviews.author: Anne Bloesser

reviews.text: Love this company! They are very responsive, respectful and detailed oriented. Marshall does an amazing job! Highly recommend this company for your pool needs.
reviews.author: Ivianka Zebrasky

reviews.text: I had a really good conversation with Savanna - the kind that reminds you how genuine people still matter in business. She was friendly, patient, and easy to talk with. You can tell she cares about people, not just transactions.
reviews.author: Ian Barford (ClearlyApps)

reviews.text: Water Wizard Pools was awesome start to finish. Super friendly, quick to answer my questions, and the pool turned out even better than I imagined. Couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Jane smith

reviews.text:
Let me begin by saying you should stop researching pool companies and sign with Water Wizard Pools.  I can honestly say, I did a lot of leg work researching pool contractors in DFW and cannot be happier that I chose WW.

From the initial contact with Bill the Designer to the finished project, I experienced nothing short of perfection and professionalism.  You will hear horror stories about pool construction, it does not occur with these guys.

Construction supervisors Adam and Rick oversee the heavy lifting, could not be a smoother process.  I was expecting a nightmare, pleasantly shocked everything was done with expertise, clean and concise.

I want to thank the entire Water Wizard team, Steve and crew for performing a great job, giving us our dream back yard.  You rock!
reviews.author: Tarley (Tarley)

reviews.text: Let me start by saying, we loved this company at first..... However, Our Polaris, we purchased from them less than a year ago, started breaking in March 2021.  For several months WE followed up with them and got the run around about why the manufacture would not repair, or preferably replace.  Yesterday, the rep, RAY was awful to deal with - CS #101: Don't argue w/client when your company in "in the wrong"!  He told me we could not have manufacture information. Nor could he give me any information on the ETA of part for equipment.  While he was blabbing on with excuses, my husband got on the phone and had a new company lined up for weekly services and a BRAND NEW Polaris!!!  Imagine that, Ray completely blamed the manufacture!!! Horrible representation of a business!!!!
reviews.author: Bridget Mitchell

reviews.text: If you’re looking for reliable fast friendly pool service this is the place to go! My pool has never looked better thanks to water wizard!!
reviews.author: Kristen Laudenslager

reviews.text: Even though we discovered that a pool is not in our budget at this time, Steve was fantastic to work with and very professional. Out of all the pool companies we had quotes from, he was by far the most up front and honest without feeling obligated. It was also great knowing the owner of the company came out to meet us first hand. He also revised our original design and quote with more options to meet our needs without coming across as inconvenienced. We will be choosing Water Wizards in the future if our situation changes.
reviews.author: Steve Marks

reviews.text: Oh how I wish I had found Water Wizard when we put the pool in! So thankful we have now partnered with them to take care of our pool. I have literally been trying to get things done to keep my pool up since 2020 to no avail. until, I hired Water Wizard. Not only is every single issue resolved they go over and beyond to make sure we are happy. If you’re looking for a company that’s knowledgeable and honest you found it. My only regret is I didn’t find them sooner!! Thank you Water Wizard for the peace of mind.
reviews.author: Barbara Cooper

reviews.text: We had a pool built by Water Wizard and they did a great job!  From design to completion, they captured just what we wanted in our pool and was there to answer questions every step of the way.  They even finished faster than expected!  We just completed pool school today and felt comfortable in knowing that if we ever had additional questions we were able to call!  I highly recommend Water Wizard to anyone.
reviews.author: Amber Jones

reviews.text: We have a small salt water pool that they have been maintaining for a while now. Not only are they a great value, but their customer service is amazing. Every person I have been in contact with has been so patient in explaining and answering all the questions I have.. which have been a lot since I'm ignorant to the maintenance of pools and all the ancillary equipment. Very impressed with the quality of the service for the price for coming out each week. They also email a job summary after each week's servicing visit that comes with pictures and detailed information. I don't know how competitive the pool service industry is, but if you've read this far, I recommend giving them a call. I don't think you'll be disappointed.
reviews.author: Amanda Hicsonmez

reviews.text: Water Wizard installed our pool last year.  Rick ran the construction project, which was handled professionally.  They were even able to work around some special needs that we had with access during the project.  Communication through the process was great.  After a year of use, I stand by my initial impression that the build quality is superb, and I won't hesitate to use Water Wizard again in our next home.
reviews.author: Cory Davis

reviews.text: Water Wizard is amazing! This swim season has been a complete pleasure. Water Wizard went above and beyond to get our pool open after a terrible experience with Sweet Southern Pools. There has been no question about them coming even after rain or in climate weather. They even brushed the liner when our vacuum was inoperable. No questions, no complaints. Just GREAT customer service.
reviews.author: Tawanda Scales

reviews.text: We 'inherited' a company that took care of our pool when we bought our house in the summer of 2020 and suffered through bad service and incomplete work before we made the move to Water Wizards a few months ago - I wish we would have done it sooner!  They are professional, fair and consistent.  I love the report that is emailed after every service detailing what was done as well as any opportunities, it's been a great experience all the way around.
reviews.author: Chris S

reviews.text:
I came upon this review page for Water Wizard a few months ago and noticed the one star review at the top (which surprised me) and then read a reply by one of the representatives of Water Wizard addressing their issues.  I've since noticed the Water Wizard response has been deleted and this person keeps reposting their bad review to keep it at the top of the list for some reason, so I wanted to share my experience with this company, which was very different from this person.  In short, we had a great experience both during the construction and four plus years of use of our Water Wizard pool.

We built our house about four years ago and decided pretty late in the building process to add a pool to a courtyard area.  This area was quite small (25x20) and the ingress to that courtyard was only about six foot wide.  I was a little worried the day they came to dig our pool that the house or perimeter fence would get damaged from the equipment, so I came home to observe.  Two guys in small bucket loaders digging and dumping and not a scratch on anything - it was amazing to watch.  When they asked me about the pattern for the stone coping, I made a decision, which my wife later didn't share, so they replaced it - no problem.  The pool turned out beautiful and we're in it almost every day.  Four years later, it's still a beautiful pool and we've had ZERO maintenance issues since then.  I would highly recommend Water Wizard to design and build your pool.  The design they did for us was perfect for our small space and as a result, we're able to enjoy it year round.
reviews.author: Bob Taylor

reviews.text: I don't write reviews often if ever, but this was a uniquely incredible service experience.  Steve did an amazing job of designing an outdoor setting that is breathtaking yet simple and reasonably priced.  We had unique topographical challenges, and he spent a significant amount of extra time, effort and company resources making it work.  Rick was the project manager, and he too was so great to work with.  He communicated clearly, professionally and regularly.  He answered questions promptly --- even when I texted or emailed well after hours not expecting a response until the next day.  His crew kept the site clean and did a fantastic job.  With Rick, I always knew exactly where we were in the project timeline and what was next.  From start to finish, this has been the easiest part of any residential project I've done, and I know that pools don't always work out that way.  I cannot recommend Water Wizard Pools more highly.
reviews.author: Robert Lydick

reviews.text: We had a unique idea for our custom pool, and Water Wizard delivered above and beyond our vision! Bill Designed just what we wanted, and was very considerate of our needs and budget. Adam and Rick brought our vision to life!  When presented with challenges (rock, drainage, adding extra features), Adam and Rick handled it all with the ease. It is safe to say this team is made of  experts! Communication was excellent from start to finish. We couldn’t be happier with our beautiful pool.
reviews.author: melanie swain

reviews.text: I have been working with water wizard pools for fours now to maintain and do equipment repairs. All that I have had contact with we’re extremely professional. They are very responsive to my concerns and completed the work expertly. I recommend them for all your pool needs
reviews.author: Edward Goldate

reviews.text: We trust the quality of Water Wizard's work so much that we have hired them to build TWO POOLS for us!  They built our first pool more than 10 years ago - and when we moved recently, we hired them to build another pool. Steve Bond, the company's owner, is very honest and worked with us to get the largest and most beautiful pool we could afford within our budget. Water Wizard has also handled our pool maintenance for well over a decade. This is a locally-owned business that has thrived because of their solid reputation, excellent customer service, and their honest and professional staff.
reviews.author: Melanie Wilson

reviews.text: Water Wizard has taken care of our pool for over 2 years now and they do a great job!! Our pool is pristine when they get done cleaning! Whenever we need any repairs they are responsive and go the extra mile to make sure the job is done right! We highly recommend them!!
reviews.author: Sarah Dean

reviews.text: Water Wizard came recommended to me when we decided on adding a pool to our home. Steve did a phenomenal job of taking our rough ideas and turning them into a design. Adam, Rick and the rest of the crew did a great job of turning that design into a reality. Everyone did a great job of answering all of our questions throughout the process. The wild weather we had this winter/spring slowed them down a little bit but it was well worth the wait. Now we have a pool that is the envy of the neighborhood. I've recommended these guys to all my friends (who after seeing our pool) are wanting one in their backyard. Thanks guys!
reviews.author: Kevin Addington

reviews.text: The best in the Metroplex, thank you, water, wizard for giving us years of great service! Much easier
reviews.author: Ryan Morris

reviews.text:
If you are looking to have a pool built, then look no further than Water Wizard.  These guys knocked it out of the park and gave me and my family our own slice of paradise right in our backyard.

Bill nailed the design that we were looking for, and Rick and Adam made it all come to life.  They kept us informed through the entire process, and answered any questions that we had.  Everyone was a true professional and delivered on everything that was promised.  I highly recommend Water Wizard to anyone in the market of having a pool designed and built.
reviews.author: Jeff Jones

reviews.text: Water Wizard Pools did a whole over haul on our pool.  They changed it over to salt water, added a gorgeous waterfall and basically gave a 1980's pool a whole facelift. It looks amazing.  The people that came out to work on the pool were all so professional, nice and very knowledgable.  I would recommend this pool company 100%!  It is an absolute please to do business with you all at Water Wizard.  I continue to do business with you since you now service my pool.
reviews.author: Julie Stuart

reviews.text:
We just completed a large new pool, patio  and pergola installation with Water Wizard.  Bill created an amazing plan, Rick and Adam ( project managers) were on top of the process and we always got an immediate response to any questions we had along the way. We absolutely love the finished project and recommend them highly!
John and Lisa Hanna
reviews.author: Lisa Hanna

reviews.text: Overall, the experience was OK. The pool they built us came out looking nice. I felt the quality was acceptable, but not overly impressive. Good for the price, as they were the cheapest of several contractors we interviewed. Their subs were hit or miss. They could have done a better job of avoiding damage to our yard. We expected it to be damaged, but the subs took no care at all to avoid it. Rick managed the project and he seemed a little overwhelmed maybe. Overall, we were satisfied for the price but did expect a little more.
reviews.author: Bobby Johnson

reviews.text: Thank You Water Wizard for transforming our dated, 1970's swimming pool and surrounding area from an eye sore into a magnificent outdoor venue! The owner, Steve Bond, and his entire crew were always there making the entire process easy. I was very nervous going into the renovation because we had a strict budget in mind. However Steve & Chad made the decision process easy and went above and beyond coming to us with very cost effective upgrades we never even thought possible. They were able to make excellent tanning ledges within the pool that we are excited to let our kids enjoy. Bring on the Texas heat. I highly recommend these Water Wizards!
reviews.author: Mike Malloy

reviews.text:
Water Wizard came out in 2 days when other companies told me 2 weeks to look at the problem. They cleaned the filter and treated the water. The next day the water was still cloudy and had debris in water. They came out and worked on the system and by
afternoon the pool was beautiful They did not charge for the 2nd service call. I was very pleased with their service and recommend them.
reviews.author: Louise Shepherd

reviews.text: These guys renovated my 20 YO pool and did a really nice job. A couple of times they offered me alternatives that accomplish what I wanted, even though it reduced the size of the job for them. I had planned to replace only part of the deck. But when they discovered some erosion underneath, they advised I should really replace that area, and even did it for cost. They even replaced the tile escudos in the pool steps when it wasn’t part of the original quote. Job site was cleaned up well. No complaints here.
reviews.author: Bill Maize

reviews.text: Water Wizard built our pool two summers ago and we LUV LUV LUV LUV it.  They did a fabulous job in the building of the pool.  It is just what we wanted.  Water Wizard also currently maintains our pool.  It is kept in beautiful condition.  I highly recommend Water Wizard pools.  They are courteous and fairly priced.
reviews.author: Jennifer Chandler

reviews.text:
We had a new project in the backyard to build out a pool house, pool, large arbor and full lanscaping.  With the pool build, we had sought out designs and bids from a number of companies to blend in with overall design and construction.  We wanted it to blend in while also have some pop, clearly custom to fit into our yard design,  and nicer elements such as bowls, water fall, lions heads, etc.    Most pool builders came in with what felt like standard base design/shape and then added a few features to customize.

My builder for the poolhouse construction had worked with Steve at water wizard on a previous job.  So we met.  Steve listened, validated and even challenged our thoughts in a healthy way.  We gave him a few examples of elements we liked and from there he gave us a rendering.  We has 2 other local companies followup that had great reputations on high end pools.  We felt most comfortable to move forward with Water wizard and within 2 to 3 weeks we had a near final design and bid.  It was within our 100 to $125k range and although we were in far northeast tarrant county by dfw airport..  they were confident they could handle.  These guys have built several commercial pools and fountains that we went to see.  That added confidence

Our build involved Adam and Rick.  Great guys and knowledgable.  Its my first pool and we had seen others have one built, so we were somewhat prepared for the invasiveness of a pool build.  Plus we had the poolhouse build going in parallel so it was like a bomb went off in the back.  Oir project was from winter 2015 to about march 2016 during all that historic rain.  I will say my only comment is communication was steady but also only a B.  The rain forced different types of delays and challenges.  As with any construction involving subs,  its always a challenge.

I have had the pool now for a year, warranty work was minimal..  touch up to stone grout. Rick came out and reviewed then had the team scheduled for the repairs.  They also handle the pool service weekly and we are swimming year round.  Hot tub was nice all fall/winter.
I highly recommend these guys and we are glad we found them.

Tommy
reviews.author: Tommy C

reviews.text: Matt from Water Wizard came because I called them to check my pool for a water leak.  He was very knowledgeable and discovered where the leak was pretty quickly.  He removed the poolside cleaner connector (which I no longer use since I got my robot cleaner) and closed off the hole.  That solved the leak that I was so worried about.  I will call them in the future for all my pool needs.  Thank you, Matt.
reviews.author: Ida Klett

reviews.text: My pool was looking like a dark green lagoon. Water Wizards sent someone out in this brutal heat, and now my pool is beautiful. That was over a month ago, they do good work, with good prices.
reviews.author: Basil Crawford

reviews.text:
Review will be updated as we go through the build process.

Review 05-07 - Water Wizards kind of had an ace in the hole going into this. They came highly recommended by my co-workers who had just built their pool.  Water Wizards went above and beyond to resolve a theft situation that they really has no responsibility to worry about. That meant a lot.

We got bids from 4 different pool builders. All of them were good but Steve and Bill knocked it out of the park. I had sent all the builders the HOA regs and the plot of the house. All of the other builders obviously didn't read the HOA rules and we spent hours watching them redesign the pool in CAD when I told them what they had wasn't per code. We also thought there would likely have to be variances to get in everything we wanted. All other builders had one design proposal and all were incomplete/incorrect.

When we walked into Water Wizards, they had 3 completed designs, all within HOA and city code guidelines with no variances. We knew instantly when we saw the first design that we had just seen our new pool. It really wasn't even close even with the word of mouth referral from my co worker that Water Wizards was it.

So far we are beyond impressed with Steve and Bill and I will continue this blog as the time goes by. Now we pray for a way drier summer than 2015.

We start the permitting process now. With our HOA and Flower Mound I know its going to take some patience.

Update 7-37-17 - Just like Steve said it would, getting the permits from Flower Mound and the HOA was a very time consuming and extensive process. However, 2 days aft the permit was final they started digging. One week later the pool was plumbed, re-barred and gunited. Its been a crazy flurry of activity. They have done an amazing amount of work in 7 days. All his contractors are super nice and we are shocked at how big and deep our pool is now thats its reality not a rendering. So far so good. We are praying for no rain......
reviews.author: Mike Skaggs

reviews.text: Super pleasant to work with! Happy with our pool! Thanks Water Wizard!!!!

reviews.text: We are glad we chose water wizard pools that have an amazing team to work with , they brought our design and ideas to life , now we can enjoy our pool for many years to come , we highly recommend you choose water wizard pools for any of your pool needs , these guys deliver we had other pool companies give us estimates and these guys were prices better gave us more for our money and did an excellent job !!! Thanks  Water Widzard , Steve ,Adam ,Alex y’all did  a great job on this one

reviews.text:
This is the best pool service in Fort Worth!

reviews.text:
Do not use this company, if could give zero stars i would.

Used them for 2 years, always want to give people a chance and make up for mistakes but Water Wizard customer service was very poor and only getting worse over time.

After many issues last year, like coming home after service and spa being empty of water, changing days of service without notice and worst of all not being able to control chemical levels.

Last summer had to deal with yellow marks all over our pool, Algae built up and it took weeks for them to finally get them all gone by controlling chemical levels.  They blamed it on time of year and where we live, ask neighbors that have their pools with 100 feet on mine and they had no issues like we had.

As compensation they said would clean our tiles for free, they put some some cleaner on the tiles which has permanently stain our tiles.   After i complained about this they said they can do nothing about it and advised me to hire a tile company to come fix the problem.

Thanks for nothing Water Wizards.

reviews.text: My experience with Water Wizard Pools has always been phenomenal.  The building process of our pool was seamless from start to finish. If you are looking for a quality pool company, then this is the one!

reviews.text: I have used WWPools for several years and have always been happy with them. My pool has pecan trees around it and is a mess to keep clean. they do a beautiful job and always respond quickly when i have other issues.

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Water Wizard Pools, they came out and got our hot tube back into working order. The price was right and the service was outstanding! Thanks everyone.

reviews.text: This service is amazing! I highly recommend Vincent and Bryan to anyone. Very responsive helpful all the time. They’ll call or text back when I need something or have a problem with my pool. I never had an issue at all.

reviews.text: Steve, Adam and Rick were all great to work with. Very professional, great communicators, and the pool is exactly what we wanted for the price we originally agreed on. I fully recommend Water Wizard Pools.

reviews.text: Met a very thorough and detailed young man named Luis today and I'm glad he's coming to clean the pool. It looks so much more different than before. Thank you

reviews.text: The best pool service in the metroplex, Savannah is wonderful and my pool is sparkling blue. Absolute Wizards of pool care!

reviews.text: They have not done the renovation project for me yet, but I plan to use them. They were all courteous and professional. They arrived as scheduled. They answered all of my questions and were very pleasant to work with. I will update my review after my pool renovation.

reviews.text: Water wizard is extremely reliable! They are here when they say they will be here. My pool is always blue and ready to use! Everyone is very polite and helpful.

reviews.text: Our pool is always perfect and ready to use thanks to Brandon and Andy, they do a great job and always address any concerns or questions I have.

reviews.text: Updated twenty year old pool with new pebble and waterfalls, beautiful stonework and attention to detail, very knowledgeable and their site manager Rick was attentive to detail and brought our plans to reality, even after the pool was done the customer service never stopped, calls were made to make sure we were happy and any questions we had  were addressed, thank you water wizards and Rick for a hassle free and great experience, we will call for any additional projects in the future.

reviews.text: Great experience from the beginning to the end. The crew we worked with went above and beyond. Bryan and Vincent were knowledgeable and very professional.

data.summary: Reviews show strong evidence of authenticity with a clear pattern of both high satisfaction and serious, recurring complaints, particularly related to post-sale service, billing, and responsiveness. The discrepancy between Google and Yelp ratings is notable and aligns with the complaint themes. The volume and specificity of negative reviews over many years indicate real, unresolved operational problems, not fake reviews.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews are generic and lack specific project details (e.g., 'Super friendly, quick to answer...')
One 5-star review is for a conversation with a salesperson, not a completed project
Several 1-star reviews are empty or contain minimal text, which is unusual but not definitive proof of fakery
authentic_signals: Specific details in many reviews (names like Steve, Rick, Adam; project challenges like 'steep uphill slope')
Varied writing styles and perspectives across ratings
Mix of praise and constructive criticism in mid-range reviews
Complaints contain specific, credible issues (Polaris repair, billing for no service, re-plastering problems) spanning many years
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.4) and Yelp (3.2). Yelp's lower rating with fewer reviews suggests a different, potentially more critical customer segment or unresolved service issues.
